requirements.notes: P13: Git status is read with porcelain v2 (branch, detached HEAD, linked worktree, upstream, ahead/behind, staged/unstaged/untracked/conflicted); selected staging and commits name only the chosen paths, so unrelated staged work survives; a non-Git folder is reported and never initialized; the module has no reset, clean, checkout, stash, or force command. Restore uses the engine's file-revert route with the recorded restore point and expected_hash, previews exact scope, exclusions, conflicts, and recovery, requires acknowledgement for later or unattributed edits, refuses a stale preview, and records every attempt. Whole-workspace restore and patch-undo remain a recorded capability gap. Final packaged-build behavior is P21/P22.
